title: Crew Manifest Sweep
description: Onboard one of each crew role and prove the RBAC boundary holds consistently across the whole roster, not just for a single admin/non-admin pair, while also confirming the /me endpoint reports the right role back to each of them.
successCondition: Register four accounts, one per role (admin, dispatcher, driver, customer), each with a distinct email. For every account: GET /api/auth/me returns 200 with user.role exactly matching the role it registered with, and user.email matching its registration email. Then GET /api/auth/admin-check for each of the four returns 200 only for the admin account and 403 FORBIDDEN for the other three, and GET /api/admin/feature-flags returns 200 for all four (that route is open to any authenticated role).
hints: Keep a table mapping email -> role -> accessToken as you build this out; the cross-checks at the end are easy to mix up otherwise.
feature-flags is intentionally NOT admin-gated (see docs/api/admin.md) — don't expect a 403 there for non-admin roles, that would be the wrong assertion.
